cell: P7 bounded local alerts + catalog/lineage quality state + Catalog Studio + persistence/recovery

implementation.alerts: Added authenticated alert rules, instances, evaluate and acknowledge operations to the public ControlPlaneClient and CLI; real SQLite telemetry drives an open alert for a failed quality run, idempotent evaluation and durable acknowledgement.
implementation.catalog_and_lineage: Added opt-in include_quality projections to catalog assets and lineage edges with bounded latest-run summaries; default responses stay unchanged and invalid query values remain rejected.
implementation.studio: Catalog Studio requests quality state for asset and lineage views and renders passed, failed, error and unknown status without widening the existing public route contract.
implementation.quality_journey: The real HTTP/SQLite journey runs passed and failed quality checks, records the alert, evaluates and acknowledges it, reads catalog and lineage quality state, replays the failed request deterministically and recovers state after restart.
implementation.recovery: The same SQLite database preserves quality history, alert status and acknowledgement across composition restart; no provider was replaced by a mock for certification.
